title: Spring WebFlux & Reactive Programming
intro: Spring WebFlux interviews test whether you understand the reactive model, not just that it's 'non-blocking'. This module is an elevation arc: it opens with reactive programming basics (the Reactive Streams contract, the push model), then Mono and Flux (the core types). Backpressure — the signature reactive problem — follows, then the WebFlux setup and R2DBC (the reactive data tier). Error handling and testing in reactive code are the applied tier. It closes with comparisons and scenario-based questions.
